nodes.description: Macrophage- and smooth muscle cell-derived matrix metalloproteinases (notably MMP-2 and MMP-9) are the predominant proteinases in the AAA wall. MMP-9 is elevated in the circulation of patients who later develop AAA.

nodes.description: A non-occlusive intraluminal thrombus commonly forms within the dilated aneurysm sac. Human thrombus transcriptomics shows enrichment of platelet-associated transcripts and GPVI, while circulating soluble GPVI associates with aneurysm diagnosis and growth.
